title: Helicopter Engineering
description: A staged helicopter engineering curriculum outline with manual assessment and a conceptual design capstone. Detailed teaching materials and resource verification remain in development.

modules.title: Calculus and differential equations
modules.resources: Stewart, Calculus: Early Transcendentals — differentiation, integration, multivariable calculus; MIT OCW 18.03SC — first- and second-order ODEs
modules.criteria: Derive velocity and acceleration from position, solve a damped second-order ODE, and validate RK4 against an analytical solution.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Linear algebra and coordinate frames
modules.resources: Strang, Introduction to Linear Algebra — matrices, transformations, eigenvalues; MIT OCW 18.06
modules.criteria: Implement body-to-inertial transformations; verify orthogonality and solve a 2-DOF eigenvalue problem.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Statics and free-body diagrams
modules.resources: Hibbeler, Engineering Mechanics: Statics — forces, moments, equilibrium, distributed loads, centroids
modules.criteria: Draw correct free-body diagrams; calculate support reactions, forces, and moments for a rotor support.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Rigid-body dynamics
modules.resources: Hibbeler, Engineering Mechanics: Dynamics — particle and rigid-body kinematics, kinetics, energy and momentum
modules.criteria: Derive rotor inertia and angular momentum; solve torque-driven angular acceleration and gyroscopic moment problems.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Numerical methods and uncertainty
modules.resources: Kreyszig, Advanced Engineering Mathematics — numerical ODEs, linear systems and error analysis
modules.criteria: Implement a stable integration solver, demonstrate timestep convergence, quantify sensitivity and unit consistency.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Strength of materials
modules.resources: Hibbeler, Mechanics of Materials — stress, strain, torsion, bending, combined loading, beam deflection and buckling
modules.criteria: Size a tail-drive shaft for torque and bending and calculate stress, deflection, and margin against an assumed allowable.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Machine elements and fatigue
modules.resources: Shigley’s Mechanical Engineering Design — loads, failure, fatigue, shafts, fasteners, springs and bearings
modules.criteria: Design a two-stage gearbox with shaft sizing, bearing life, bolted connections, fatigue calculations and justified safety factors.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Gears, lubrication and tribology
modules.resources: Shigley — chapters on gears, gear trains and lubrication; Dudley’s Handbook of Practical Gear Design
modules.criteria: Calculate gear ratios, forces, torque, efficiencies and a preliminary gear failure margin; document lubrication assumptions.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Materials, fracture and composites
modules.resources: Callister, Materials Science and Engineering — mechanical properties, failure, heat treatment; Jones, Mechanics of Composite Materials — laminate mechanics
modules.criteria: Compare steel, titanium, aluminum and laminate candidates; calculate a laminate stiffness example and a simplified crack stress intensity.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Thermodynamics and heat transfer
modules.resources: Moran et al., Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics — control volumes and cycles; Incropera, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer — conduction/convection
modules.criteria: Close a simplified turboshaft energy balance and estimate gearbox oil cooling load.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Fluid mechanics and vibration
modules.resources: White, Fluid Mechanics — conservation, pipe losses and dimensional analysis; Rao, Mechanical Vibrations — SDOF forced response and resonance
modules.criteria: Compute a hydraulic pressure drop, a resonance frequency and damping response for a simple rotating assembly.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

stages.name: CAD and Manufacturing
stages.description: Parametric CAD, drawings, tolerancing and FEA

modules.title: SolidWorks parts and design intent
modules.resources: SOLIDWORKS official training — Getting Started, Sketches and Parts; Planchard, Engineering Design with SOLIDWORKS — part modeling
modules.criteria: Create ten fully constrained, editable parts; modify master dimensions without broken features.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Assemblies and motion
modules.resources: SOLIDWORKS training — Assemblies and Mates; Planchard — assembly and motion lessons
modules.criteria: Build a kinematically valid swashplate assembly; demonstrate collective and cyclic motion without collisions.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Engineering drawings and GD&T
modules.resources: Giesecke, Technical Drawing with Engineering Graphics — sections on dimensions, sections and tolerances; ASME Y14.5
modules.criteria: Produce manufacturing drawings with datum system, fits and a quantitative tolerance stack.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Manufacturing and inspection
modules.resources: Kalpakjian and Schmid, Manufacturing Engineering and Technology — machining, forming, casting, joining and metrology
modules.criteria: Select processes and inspection plans for five parts, identifying critical dimensions, tooling constraints and cost drivers.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Finite element analysis
modules.resources: Logan, A First Course in the Finite Element Method — bar/beam elements and assembly; SOLIDWORKS Simulation tutorials
modules.criteria: Derive an element stiffness matrix, compare cantilever FEA against beam theory and demonstrate mesh convergence.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

stages.name: Rotorcraft Aerodynamics
stages.description: Hover, blade aerodynamics, forward flight and wake

modules.title: Helicopter systems and controls
modules.resources: FAA Helicopter Flying Handbook — helicopter fundamentals, aerodynamics, controls, components and weight and balance (edition and reading locations require verification)
modules.criteria: Explain controls, major components, induced flow, autorotation and CG effects; solve a weight-and-balance exercise.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Airfoil aerodynamics
modules.resources: Anderson, Fundamentals of Aerodynamics — airfoils, viscous effects, compressibility; Leishman — airfoil characteristics
modules.criteria: Compute sectional lift/drag, Reynolds and Mach numbers at blade stations and explain stall and compressibility constraints.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Momentum theory and hover performance
modules.resources: Leishman, Principles of Helicopter Aerodynamics, 2nd ed. — hovering rotor momentum theory; Johnson, Helicopter Theory — hover performance
modules.criteria: Derive ideal induced power P=T^(3/2)/sqrt(2 rho A); compare rotor sizes and density altitudes and state omitted losses.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Blade element and BEMT
modules.resources: Leishman — blade element theory and blade element momentum theory
modules.criteria: Implement radial-element integration yielding thrust, torque, power and spanwise loading; perform convergence and sensitivity checks.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Forward flight and trim
modules.resources: Leishman — forward flight, induced velocity and flapping; Padfield, Helicopter Flight Dynamics — trim
modules.criteria: Calculate advance ratio and azimuthal velocity; formulate a simplified forward-flight trim with explicitly stated modeling limits.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Unsteady aerodynamics and autorotation
modules.resources: Leishman — rotor wake, unsteady aerodynamics and autorotation
modules.criteria: Explain dynamic inflow, vortex effects and power flow during autorotation; implement one simplified dynamic-response case.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Blade structures and aeroelasticity
modules.resources: Johnson, Helicopter Theory — rotor blade dynamics; Hodges & Pierce, Introduction to Structural Dynamics and Aeroelasticity — vibration and flutter
modules.criteria: Compute centrifugal and bending loads, modal frequencies and distinguish structural resonance from aeroelastic instability.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Rotor hub and swashplate
modules.resources: Johnson — rotor kinematics and hub dynamics; FAA Helicopter Flying Handbook — components and controls (edition and reading locations require verification)
modules.criteria: Model blade flapping, lead-lag and feathering; produce an articulated conceptual swashplate with motion-envelope checks.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Main gearbox and rotor drive
modules.resources: Shigley — gears, shafts, bearings, fatigue; Dudley — practical gear design
modules.criteria: Calculate drive ratios, gear and shaft loads, bearing life and thermal demands; document lubrication and key failure paths.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Tail rotor and anti-torque drive
modules.resources: Leishman — rotor performance; Johnson — helicopter trim and anti-torque systems
modules.criteria: Calculate main-rotor reaction torque, tail thrust at given moment arm, and tail drive power with sensitivity analysis.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Turboshaft and engine integration
modules.resources: Saravanamuttoo et al., Gas Turbine Theory — Brayton cycle and turboshaft components; Farokhi, Aircraft Propulsion
modules.criteria: Analyze an ideal Brayton cycle, estimate power variation and create a conceptual engine/rotor power budget.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Fuselage, landing gear and hydraulics
modules.resources: Megson, Aircraft Structures for Engineering Students — load paths and buckling; Esposito, Fluid Power with Applications — hydraulic circuits
modules.criteria: Develop preliminary fuselage load paths, simplified landing impact energy analysis and actuator pressure/flow calculations.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

stages.name: Dynamics and Avionics
stages.description: Flight dynamics, estimation and embedded control

modules.title: Rigid body flight dynamics and stability
modules.resources: Padfield, Helicopter Flight Dynamics — trim, stability and handling qualities; Nelson, Flight Stability and Automatic Control — equations of motion
modules.criteria: Derive 6-DOF equations, linearize about a trim point, calculate eigenvalues and simulate disturbance response.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Feedback and digital control
modules.resources: Franklin et al., Feedback Control of Dynamic Systems — PID, state-space, frequency response; MIT 16.333 notes
modules.criteria: Design a simulated rotor-speed controller with anti-windup; evaluate poles, stability margin and response metrics.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Sensors and Kalman filtering
modules.resources: Grewal & Andrews, Kalman Filtering: Theory and Practice — filtering; MIT 16.333 sensor estimation notes
modules.criteria: Implement complementary and Kalman filters using simulated IMU data; report drift and estimation errors.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Embedded real-time avionics
modules.resources: Liu, Real-Time Systems — scheduling and synchronization; Franklin et al., Digital Control of Dynamic Systems
modules.criteria: Specify a deterministic sensor/control task schedule, watchdog policy, fault model and timing tests.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Integrated simulation
modules.resources: Padfield — nonlinear flight models; relevant MIT 16.333 exercises
modules.criteria: Create a simulation-only helicopter model with sensor noise, disturbances and fault-injection tests.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Systems engineering and traceability
modules.resources: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook — requirements, architecture, verification; Kossiakoff et al., Systems Engineering Principles and Practice
modules.criteria: Create a requirements-to-test matrix covering helicopter-level needs and subsystem interfaces.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Reliability and safety assessment
modules.resources: Bahr, System Safety Engineering and Risk Assessment — FMEA and fault trees; SAE ARP4761A
modules.criteria: Perform an initial functional hazard assessment, FMEA and fault tree for selected systems; close major critical logic gaps.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Regulatory framework and compliance
modules.resources: 14 CFR Part 27; FAA AC 27-1; 14 CFR Part 29 for comparison — applicability, current revisions and reading locations require verification
modules.criteria: Map ten relevant requirements to conceptual compliance evidence and identify unresolved certification work.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Mission requirements and architecture
modules.resources: Capstone specification and NASA Systems Engineering Handbook
modules.criteria: Define a two-seat 700 kg illustrative design brief with budgets, assumptions, requirements and traceability.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Rotor preliminary sizing
modules.resources: Leishman and Johnson; your validated BEMT notebook
modules.criteria: Produce disk area, blade geometry, rpm and hover/forward-performance estimates with assumptions and sensitivities.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Powertrain and rotor system CAD
modules.resources: Shigley, Dudley, Johnson; SOLIDWORKS assemblies
modules.criteria: Produce main transmission and rotor hub CAD with kinematic checks, loads and bill of materials.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Airframe and integration
modules.resources: Megson and Kalpakjian; SOLIDWORKS assembly and drawing tools
modules.criteria: Integrate equipment envelopes and fuselage load paths, create key drawings and check fit, CG and major interferences.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Controls and system simulation
modules.resources: Padfield, Franklin; previous flight dynamics models
modules.criteria: Demonstrate simulated trim, stabilization and fault response, recording limitations.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.

modules.title: Independent design review
modules.resources: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook; 14 CFR Part 27; all prior deliverables
modules.criteria: Publish a reproducible design dossier, verification matrix, hazard register, open-issues register and review resolution record.
modules.assessment: Submit worked calculations and a practical deliverable; score at least 80% on a reviewed problem set and resolve all critical rubric errors.
